latest_release.body:
## Vulnerability fix for `IO.unzip`

sbt team received a security report [GHSA-p8jf-532w-4p65](https://github.com/sbt/sbt/security/advisories/GHSA-p8jf-532w-4p65) from [Stas Shevchenko](https://github.com/stasimus) that despite previous attempt to fix it, `IO.unzip` and its variants contain a zip slip vulnerability. sbt 1.13.1 and 2.0.12 fix this bug.

## updates and bug fixes

* fix: End the client connection when the channel's write thread stops by @retronym in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/9991
* Update sbtn to 2.1.0-e5346417 in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/9996
* fix: Fix run task by @xuwei-k in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/9963
* IO 1.13.6 by @eed3si9n in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/9989
* Zinc 2.0.5 + IPC Socket 1.8.1 by @eed3si9n in https://github.com/sbt/sbt/pull/9993

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sbt/sbt/compare/v2.0.11...v2.0.12
